## Generated (not source-controlled)

- `engine/engine.vcxproj`
- `engine/engine.vcxproj.filters`
- Per-configuration `bin-obj/x86_64/{Debug,Release}/engine/assimp/`: generated
  `include/assimp/config.h`, `assimp-c-api.def`, `assimp-c-api.lib`, `assimp-c-api.exp`.
- Per-configuration `bin/x86_64/{Debug,Release}/engine/`: built engine, deployed
  `assimp-vc143-mt.dll`, and ordinary build outputs.

Temporary smoke-check executables and downloaded comparison archives from setup
are not required build outputs or maintained test entry points. See the
[design wiki](../../docs/Assets.md) for the current model-loading pipeline.
